title: Consultant(e) national(e) en charge de la mise en place de la plateforme SIG Education (WEBSIG)
why_not: Not a learner system: WebSIG is a platform georeferencing school establishments for the carte scolaire, operational at MINEDUB with UNESCO technical support and World Bank and AFD funds; a 2025 MoU through PAREC has UNESCO deconcentrate the SIGE to the ten regions and extend WebSIG to all six sector ministries, hosted at the INS. No learner record and no school entry. Class on this text: census (school map). A vacancy reproduced on a job board; dated from its 20/04/2026 deadline.
